It feels like it has to be narrowing as things like government support comes off, so how should we think about that developing? Really just interested in any colour you can give us there. We have demonstrated over the last number of years, and it's well digested inside of the bank, that this rule of variable compensation at Barclays will start with a reflection of the profitability of the wholesale business overall. Profitability goes up, accrual goes up. Profitability comes under pressure, we will try to secure profitability by taking down the accrual of variable compensation.
